notes.full427: Both endpoints still miss fabric cords and soften clouds/small facade details. The expanded model has no convincing visual advantage in these selected examples.
notes.known: Plate surface texture is softened relative to approximate AHD; 7D flat colors are smooth and retain a bright point. Arms look similar.
notes.unseen: Broad boundaries remain; fine surface variation and small marks stay soft. AHD references are approximate and retain noise.
notes.analytic: Neutral gray is nearly uniform. Weak bright period16 stripes are attenuated; dark period8 stripes are largely absent in both outputs. Similar visible behavior across arms.
notes.gfx: Smooth sky; building lattice and wires remain soft, foliage smears and chain-link wires lack reference crispness. The ISO100 f/5.6 image differs in aperture/exposure/motion and is not exact GT.
notes.three-camera: GFX50R seams and cement variation look crisper than the shown RawNIND comparator; true fine texture versus residual noise is unverified. Q2 dark textures stay soft. Sony windows/fuselage remain smooth with minor edge/color differences. No broad decisive advantage is established; arms look similar.
notes.colored-CPU: Orange retains slight coarse variation/color error; neutral gray is nearly uniform.
notes.hue: Gray/orange look nearly uniform at preview resolution. Saturated magenta has coarse variation and bias in V60/V63/V64, visibly stronger violet shift in the selected V64 view. Nonlocal magenta shows a large color error and patterned residual. No universal color solution.
notes.extra-GFX: Saturated neon boundaries and platform structures remain soft. ISO100 reference is differently exposed/sharpened by aperture, not exact GT. Similar restored appearances across arms.

result.count_correction: Previous prose estimated56 and the first16 snapshot retained that estimate. Actual frozen workers specify38 primary+12 hue+4 supplementary=54, plus4 selected CPU-color previews=58. All58 actual paths are enumerated and viewed; no worker or archived plan was changed.
